Implementation Plan ## Implementation plan: let self-repo implement runs commit allowlisted new files under `.github/ai/` (unblock fix-up for #9111) Planning ref: `orchestrator/project-8969` @ `ad73dffef6850a4650529fa905461856b356135c`. The integration branch matches its metadata, so no mismatch. Clarification: the orchestrator auto-answered. There were no questions to map. ## Files likely to change - `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh` - `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py` - `README.md` - `changelog.d/unblock-9111-r1-self-repo-github-ai-adds.md` (new) - `agents.d/unblock-9111-r1-self-repo-github-ai-adds.md` (new) ## Acceptance ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py::test_commit_helper_self_repo_stages_allowlisted_github_ai_file red-on-base ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py::test_commit_helper_self_repo_github_ai_add_flag_off ACCEPTANCE: test tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py::test_commit_helper_consumer_repo_never_stages_github_ai_file ACCEPTANCE: post-merge none: the change only affects the implement commit step, which runs on the next self-repo implement dispatch, not in a post-merge workflow ## Automation and wiring (§20.E) - **Script type:** this only changes an existing script, `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh`. It adds no new script, no single-use script and no supervisor, so `docs/scripts-pending-removal.md` needs no entry. - **Entry point:** no new wiring. The script already runs from `.github/workflows/implement.yml` (the commit step, `bash "${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR:-scripts}/implement_commit_changes.sh"`), triggered by `/approved` and by orchestrator dispatch. - **New env var:** `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED`. Its default lives in the script itself (§8), so `implement.yml` does not change. - **DB work:** none. ## Functions or modules to implement ### 1. `scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh`: new block after the untracked-file add Insert the block after line 379 (`git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z -- "${add_o_excludes[@]}" | xargs -0 -r git add --`) and before the consumer `scripts/.gitignore` reset loop. **Leave unchanged:** - line 349: `add_o_excludes` keeps `':!.github/ai'` in every case; - line 378: `add_u_excludes`; - every consumer branch. **When it runs:** only when `is_self_repo == "true"`. **Flag parsing.** Use one new local, e.g. `self_repo_github_ai_flag`. Before adding it, grep the script so the name doesn't collide (§10). - Read `"${IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED-}"` and lowercase it with `${var,,}`. - `""` or `true` → enabled. - `false` → disabled, with no warning. - Anything else → disabled, plus `echo "::warning::IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED='' is not true/false; self-repo .github/ai additions disabled."` **Building the allowlist.** Reuse the guard's parser; do not parse `files_touched` again in shell. - Pick the input the commit-time scope guard (lines 597–606) already uses: - normal route: `--issue-body-file "${ISSUE_BODY_FILE:-}"`; - `HEAL_ROUTE=true`: `--allowlist-file "${HEAL_SCOPE_FILE:-}"`. Use `:-`, not `:?`, so an unset value cannot abort the script. - Run `python3 "${IMPLEMENT_STAGED_SUPPORT_RUN_DIR:-scripts}/files_touched_scope_guard.py"` with that input plus: - `--issue-number "${ISSUE_NUMBER:-}"`; - `--staged-file `; - `--allowlist-out `. - Wrap the call in `set +e` / `set -e`. With an empty staged list the helper exits `0` and writes the normalized allowlist (`main()` → `evaluate()` → `normalize_allowlist`), or exits `10` when there is no allowlist. - Stage nothing when: - the helper file is missing; - the input file is empty or unset; - the exit code is anything other than `0`; - the allowlist file is empty. In each case print one non-contractual notice, e.g. `::notice::self-repo .github/ai additions skipped (reason=no_allowlist|helper_unavailable|helper_rc_)`, without the new log prefix. Remove both temp files. **Choosing which files to stage.** Enumerate candidates with `git ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z -- .github/ai`, read via `while IFS= read -r -d '' p`. Stage a candidate `p` only if all of these hold: - the allowlist file has a line exactly equal to `p` (compare with `grep -Fxq -- "$p"` or a bash loop of exact string compares); - that matched entry has no `*`, `?` or `[`, and does not end in `/`. Since the match is exact and `p` is a file path, this also rules out directory entries and globs such as `.github/ai/` or `.github/ai/**`; - `p` is a regular file and not a symlink (`[ -f "$p" ] && [ ! -L "$p" ]`). **For each staged file:** run `git add -- "$p"`, then `echo "IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD path=${p}"`. Add a short comment above the block citing #9111, the unblock fix-up, and why `.github/ai` stays in `add_o_excludes`. **Guards that still apply.** Later guards keep running on the staged set: - the automation-path grant guard (lines 520–571; needs `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true` and an exact grant); - the files_touched scope guard; - the destructive guard. ### 2. `tests/test_implement_post_codex_recovery.py`: three new tests Follow the pattern of `test_commit_helper_rolls_back_post_commit_scope_lock_violation`: - `_bootstrap_git_repo`; - copy `IMPLEMENT_COMMIT_SCRIPT` and `FILES_TOUCHED_SCOPE_GUARD` into `scripts/` and commit them; - `_isolated_test_env`; - `subprocess.run(["bash", "scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh"], ...)`. Grep the file for the test names first so none collide. **a) `test_commit_helper_self_repo_stages_allowlisted_github_ai_file`** - Setup: - `GITHUB_REPOSITORY=shubhodeep1/coding-workflows`, `ISSUE_NUMBER=948`. - The issue body file has a `files_touched:` block listing `.github/ai/x.json` and `tests/new_test.py`. - Untracked `.github/ai/x.json`, `.github/ai/y.json` and `tests/new_test.py`. - `ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS=true`. - `AUTOMATION_PATH_GRANT_FILE` points to JSON `{"schema_version":"automation_path_grant.v1","trusted":true,"issue_number":948,"paths":[".github/ai/x.json"]}`. - Assertions: - exit code 0; - stdout contains `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD path=.github/ai/x.json` and no line for `y.json`; - `git show --name-only --format= HEAD` contains `.github/ai/x.json` and `tests/new_test.py` but not `.github/ai/y.json`; - `y.json` is still untracked. **b) `test_commit_helper_self_repo_github_ai_add_flag_off`** - Same setup, parametrized over the flag values `false`, `FALSE` and `bogus`. - Assertions: - no `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD` line; - `x.json` is not committed; - the `::warning::` line appears only for `bogus`. **c) `test_commit_helper_consumer_repo_never_stages_github_ai_file`** - Setup: `GITHUB_REPOSITORY=owner/repo` with the same allowlisted, untracked `x.json`. - Assertions: - no prefix line; - `x.json` is not committed; - the commit contents match what the current code commits (only `tests/new_test.py`). - Optionally, a self-repo case with no `files_touched` block in the issue body, asserting nothing under `.github/ai` is staged. ### 3. Docs - **`README.md`:** add one Variables-table row next to `ENFORCE_FILES_TOUCHED`: `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED | No | true | implement`, describing the exact-path-only staging, the self-repo-only scope and the off-switch semantics. - **`changelog.d/unblock-9111-r1-self-repo-github-ai-adds.md`:** a `` fragment, ending `Refs #9111.` - **`agents.d/unblock-9111-r1-self-repo-github-ai-adds.md`:** a block under `` with the bullet `` - `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD` `` (`scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh`, stdout, one line per staged file: `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD path=`), plus `LOG_PREFIX.name=IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD`. Do not edit `agents.md` directly (§25). ## Data structures affected - Nothing persists. There are two temporary files (an empty staged list and the allowlist output), both removed after use. - There is a new stdout log line, `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD path=

`. ## API or interface changes - **New env var:** `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADDS_ENABLED` (default on; only `false` turns it off; any other value turns it off with a warning). - **New contractual log prefix:** `IMPLEMENT_SELF_REPO_GITHUB_AI_ADD`. - **Unchanged:** no existing identifier, output key or flag changes. `files_touched_scope_guard.py` is reused through its existing CLI. Data flow: 1. The untracked add at line 379 runs as before, with `.github/ai` still excluded. 2. If the repo is the self repo and the flag is on, the guard helper is called with the issue body (or heal scope) and an empty staged list, and writes the normalized allowlist. 3. Each untracked regular file under `.github/ai` whose path matches an exact, non-glob allowlist entry is added, with one log line per file. 4. The existing automation-path grant, files_touched and destructive guards check the final staged set. Failure modes: - **Helper missing or errors:** - Symptom: notice line, nothing extra staged. - Recovery: same as today's behaviour. - **Issue has no allowlist:** - Symptom: notice line, nothing staged. - Recovery: add an exact `files_touched` entry to the issue. - **Allowlisted file but no automation grant:** - Symptom: the existing `IMPLEMENT_AUTOMATION_PATH_GUARD outcome=rejected` line. - Recovery: the existing grant process. This is intended, and the new step does not bypass it. ## Decisions ### D1 — Read the allowlist through the existing guard CLI, not a new shell parser - **Chosen:** call `files_touched_scope_guard.py` with an empty `--staged-file` and `--allowlist-out` to get the normalized allowlist. - **Alternatives considered:** a new `--print-allowlist` mode in the guard; parsing the `files_touched:` block in bash. - **Why:** the issue requires "the same input files_touc
